q: If Alex ___ me, I will email the documents. (BU 15-16)
e: First Conditional-এ If-clause বর্তমানে থাকে (Present Indefinite) এবং main clause-এ will + base verb বসে। If-clause-এ will বসে না, তাই asks সঠিক। অর্থ: অ্যালেক্স আমাকে বললে আমি কাগজপত্র ইমেইল করে দেব। Will ask ও will tell if-clause-এ বসে না। Has asked চলতে পারে, কিন্তু এই ছাঁচে সরল Present Indefinite-ই সবচেয়ে স্বাভাবিক।

q: If they had invited me, I ______ the party.
It is high time (do) the work.
e: এখানে time-এর পরে কোনো কর্তা নেই, তাই It is high time-এর পরে to-infinitive বসে: to do। অর্থ: কাজটা করার সময় হয়ে গেছে। did বসাতে হলে আগে কর্তা লাগত (It is high time he did the work)। doing ও does এই কাঠামোতে বসে না। নিয়ম: কর্তা থাকলে past verb, কর্তা না থাকলে to + verb।

q: Identify the correct one from the following sentence:
o: Had I seen him, I would tell him the matter.
Had I seen him, I would told him the matter.
Had I seen him, I would have tell him the matter.
Had I seen him, I would have told him the matter.

q: Identify the correct sentence:
o: Were I to refuse they'd have been very annoyed.
Were I to refuse they'd be very annoyed.
If I were to refuse they'd have very annoyed.
If I were to refuse will be very annoyed.

q: He told the matter as if he ________ it.
If I had known about the traffic, _____________.
o: I would have taken a different route
I have taken a different route
I would take a different route

q: He spells the words as if he _____ a student of kindergarten.
Pick the right word to complete the sentence: She cried as if she ______ hurt badly.
It is high time to _________ the enemy.
e: It is high time বা It is time-এর পরে সরাসরি to থাকলে verb-এর base form বসে, তাই to attack। আর এর পরে নতুন subject এলে সেই subject-এর verb past form হয়। উদাহরণ: It is high time we gave up smoking; It is high time to change our attitude. বাক্যের অর্থ: শত্রুকে আক্রমণ করার এখনই সময়।

q: If humans were totally deprived of sleep, they_______ hallucination, anxiety, coma, and eventually, death.
Which sentence is correct?
o: If she had more time, she would have travel the world.
If she has more time, she would travel the world.
If she had more time, she will travel the world.
If she had more time, she would travel the world.

q: I would tell you the answer if I ___ what it was.
e: main clause-এ would tell আছে, তাই এটি Type 2 conditional, আর If-clause-এ Past Indefinite বসবে: knew। অর্থ: উত্তরটা কী, তা জানলে আমি তোমাকে বলতাম (আসলে জানি না)। had known বসলে main clause-এ would have told লাগত। know বা have known এই কাঠামোতে মেলে না।

q: He spoke as though he ___ the ghost.
e: As though বা as if-এর আগের অংশ past indefinite হলে এর পরের অংশে past perfect (had + V3) বসে। এখানে মূল verb spoke অতীতের, আর ভূত দেখার ঘটনাটি তার আগেই ঘটেছে বলে ধরা হচ্ছে, তাই had seen সঠিক। উদাহরণ: She cried as though she had lost everything। মনে রাখুন: মূল verb present হলে as though-এর পরে past indefinite চলে, আর be verb-এর জায়গায় were বসে। Saw, sees ও will see এ বাক্যের tense-এর সঙ্গে মেলে না।

q: Complete the sentence with the correct verb: I wish I ___ a king.
If I had seen him there, I ____ his help.
Choose the correct sentence.
o: If she had studied, she would passed the exam.
If she studied, she would have passed the exam.
If she had studied, she would have passed the exam.
If she had studied, she has passed the exam.

q: Choose the sentence with the first conditional-
o: If she gets the job, she will move to a new city.
If she gets the job, she would move to a new city.
If she gets the job, she would have moved to a new city.
If she got the job, she will move to a new city.
e: First conditional ভবিষ্যতে ঘটতে পারে এমন বাস্তব শর্ত বোঝায়। গঠন: If + present simple, subject + will + base verb। তাই If she gets the job, she will move to a new city শুদ্ধ। If clause-এ got বা main clause-এ would, would have থাকলে সেগুলো অন্য conditional-এর গঠন। উদাহরণ: If you want success, you will work hard.

q: If you had walked fast, you ______ the station. Choose the right form of the verb -
No sooner had ___________ the phone rang.
